rationale: The request refines existing Wave 2 smart-search SRS, and one MCP default conflicts with the current IR-MCP-014 contract. Multi-aspect split is required across APP, DOC, and MCP surfaces.

affected_existing_reqs.diff_summary: Adds visible model status, registration modal, optional key/model discovery, and chunk size field.
Adds registration-triggered background indexing and Settings percentage progress.
Clarifies semantic index invalidation/removal after explicit model registration/change/removal.
Adds output/candidate limit discipline to hybrid ranking.
Changes smart_search limit default from 10 to 20 and keeps bounded larger limits.
Refreshes seven-tool parity to depend on the updated smart_search contract.
